title: Model Paper 3
html:
Model Paper 3 follows the MECEE-BL Group I paper question for question: Zoology 40, Botany 40, Chemistry 50, Physics 50 and Mental Agility Test 20, 200 single-best-answer questions in 3 hours. Take it as a timed test, with no book and no pause, then read the explained key at the end.

Instructions
  • 200 questions, 180 minutes, 200 marks. Each question has four options and exactly one best answer.
  • +1 for a right answer, −0.25 for a wrong answer, 0 for a blank. Score = R − 0.25 W.
  • Two options ruled out? Answer. Nothing ruled out? Skip it unless time is spare (see §1.3 of the exam guide).
  • Constants are given in the question where needed; take g = 10 m s⁻² unless a question says otherwise.
Subject Questions Question numbers
Zoology 40 1–40
Botany 40 41–80
Chemistry 50 81–130
Physics 50 131–180
Mental Agility Test 20 181–200

The questions in each subject follow the official unit weightage of the MEC syllabus (exam guide, §1.2). Score yourself: score = right − 0.25 × wrong. Around 150 is a strong paper; the merit list is cut from the 50th percentile upward, so what matters is beating the field, not a fixed mark.
